evidence: ESCA-XPS analyses were performed with a Perkin-Elmer PHI 5400 ESCA System. Temperature programmed desorption (TPD) of hydrogen was performed in a volumetric flow apparatus with nitrogen–argon (99.5% N2, 0.5% Ar) as a carrier gas. Hydrogen chemisorption measurements were performed using an automatic chemisorption apparatus (Sorptomatic 1900, Carlo Erba Instruments). The BET specific surface areas were measured with an automatic physisorption–chemisorption apparatus (Sorptomatic 1900, Carlo Erba Instruments).
